name: Coffee Latte
summary: The unflavored can in the Throne line: cold brew on ultra-filtered skim milk with 10 g of protein and 150 mg of caffeine per 11 oz can, at 140 calories and 22 g of sugar. Throne says its three flavored lattes are made with lactose-free milk and leaves this can out: its ingredients list ultra-filtered skim milk with lactase enzyme, and the brand makes no lactose-free claim for it, so this can is listed as skim while its siblings are lactose-free on purpose.
